reviews.text: Nice velvety texture, long lasting, not drying lips. Colour went out too pink for me (22) but manageable, i'm just applying less as it's quite pigmented. Overall good product, planning to try another colour
reviews.zh: 絲絨質地唔錯，持久，唔會令嘴唇乾。顏色(22)對我嚟講太粉，不過可以接受，我減少用量就得，畢竟好顯色。整體嚟講係好產品，計劃試其他色。

reviews.text: My fav, perfect long wear staining. Matte but not drying. Look at the pot formulation colour in the photos though, the lips are not accurate at all
reviews.zh: 我最愛，持久染色超完美。霧面但唔會乾。留意返相入面 pot 裝嘅顏色，同實際上唇完全唔同。

reviews.text: I hate getting dry lips, so I was a bit worried since this product is on the matte side. However, it does not accentuate or emphasize dryness on the lips. It actually works as a great base for any coral makeup. It looks much better in person than in my photo, and it’s so pretty once applied. I would repurchase.
reviews.zh: 我好怕嘴唇乾，所以本來有啲擔心，因為呢款係霧面嘅。但係佢唔會強調或者凸顯唇部乾燥。反而係一款好好嘅底霜，襯任何珊瑚色妝。實物望落靚過相，搽上後真係好靚。我會再回購。

reviews.text: I love these pots. The colors are so pretty and the packaging is too. Color is lovely and is really pigmented. Highly recommend these!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢啲 pot 裝。顏色好靚，包裝都係。顏色好靚而且好顯色。極推薦！

reviews.text: These pots are so pretty to look at! They’re lovely and the texture feels very light and airy. The colour payoff is excellent and lasts a long time. I’d prefer if they’d included a silicone mini brush instead of bristles, but otherwise I love these! Only thing I would say is #20 Apple Candy looks less red on my lips and leans a bit orange. But I still really like it!
reviews.zh: 呢啲 pot 望落好靚！好靚，質地好輕好空氣感。顯色一流，持久度都高。如果可以附送矽膠細掃而唔係毛掃會更好，但除此之外我好鍾意！唯一要講係 #20 Apple Candy 喺我唇上望落冇咁紅，反而偏橙少少。但我仲係好鍾意！

reviews.text: The packaging is so super cute! The colour payoff is amazing and lasts for ages, doesn’t emphasise my lip lines and feels light and airy. I haven’t tried the brush yet and have used my finger, which isn’t really a good idea as it stains and doesn’t want to wash off! I’ll use a silicone lip brush in future and will order more colours soon!
reviews.zh: 包裝超級可愛！顯色度一流，而且持久度高，完全唔會突出我嘅唇紋，感覺輕盈無負擔。我仲未試過用佢支掃，一直用手指上，其實唔係太好嘅做法，因為會染色，而且好難洗甩！之後我會改用矽膠唇掃，亦都會再訂多幾隻色！

reviews.text: I love the texture but the color was but more saturated than I thought. I’m spring light/pale tone and it came out little too dark on my lips.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意佢嘅質地，不過顏色比我預期中再飽和啲。我係春季淺色／白皙膚色，搽出嚟對我嚟講有少少太深。

reviews.text: 09 Hazy Rose evens out my lip colour! I did a quick lip touch up and loved the mini brush that came with it. My only gripe is that the pot is without a mirror. Otherwise, I love the colour on me (N23) in natural light!
reviews.zh: 09 Hazy Rose 令我嘅唇色更均勻！我快速補咗一下唇，附送嘅迷你掃好好用。我唯一要彈嘅係盒裝冇鏡。除咗呢點，我好鍾意呢個色（N23）喺自然光下嘅效果！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
